story: After a turbulent opening phase, the decisive breakaway formed after 36 kilometres. Kevin Vermaerke briefly attempted a solo move, but the strongest climbers ultimately emerged from the break. Marco Brenner won the sprint ahead of Santiago Buitrago. Among the GC contenders, Enric Mas and Felix Gall gained time on their rivals.
